summary.headline: Anthropic IPO talk at $2 trillion; Nvidia aces ARC-AGI-3 public levels
summary.body: A modest day. The New York Times reported bankers have floated an Anthropic IPO raising more than $100 billion at a $2 trillion valuation, another sign of Power Concentration, which nudged Enslaved God and Benevolent Dictator up. Brazil's split sovereign-supercomputer bet on Huawei and Nvidia pulled the other way, deliberately avoiding dependence on one vendor. Nvidia's agent harness scored 100 on public ARC-AGI-3 levels, adding to Capability Velocity, and OpenAI asked California to require monitoring during training, a small plus for Alignment & Control. Horizon Balance edged up to -4.19.
summary.movers_note: Enslaved God +0.2 from the Anthropic IPO report (+0.14) and Nvidia's ARC-AGI-3 result (+0.08), less Brazil (-0.09); Protector God +0.1 from ARC-AGI-3 (+0.07) and OpenAI's SB 53 push (+0.06).
coming_up: Possible Anthropic IPO in October, as floated by bankers

events.title: Brazil commits $444M to sovereign AI supercomputers split between Huawei and Nvidia
events.summary: Brazil is funding a Huawei-iFlytek supercomputer project in Rio and a separate tender likely favouring Nvidia, to avoid dependence on one vendor or country.
events.reason: Sovereign compute spreads capacity; modest size.

events.title: Anthropic bankers float October IPO raising $100B+ at $2T valuation
events.summary: The New York Times reported bankers told investors an Anthropic IPO could raise more than $100B at a record $2 trillion valuation.
events.reason: Banker-sourced intention; signal of capital concentration.

events.title: OpenAI urges California to add training-time monitoring to SB 53
events.summary: Politico reported OpenAI asked California to require monitoring of frontier models during training, citing the AI-agent hacks.
events.reason: Lab lobbying for stronger oversight; proposal only.

events.title: Nvidia harness scores 100 on public ARC-AGI-3 levels
events.summary: Nvidia's AVO agent harness reached a score of 100 on 183 public ARC-AGI-3 levels; Nvidia notes comparisons are not controlled.
events.reason: Self-reported benchmark jump on public set only.
